brand_identity.tagline: Cinematic Invitations for Life's Greatest Celebrations
brand_identity.archetype: Hybrid: Luxury Ceremonial (Guest Card) & Warm Editorial SaaS (Host Studio)
brand_identity.target_platform: Mobile-First Web App (Optimized for Android Chrome & iOS Safari)

step_1_intro.name: Intro Screen
elements: Guest personalized greeting badge 'To: Guest Name'
Animated envelope or curtain centerpiece
Primary Action: 'Tap to Open'
Secondary Action: 'Skip Intro' link
step_1_intro.rule: Must show personalized query param 'to' or fall back to 'Special Guest'

step_2_reveal.name: Template Reveal Animation
step_2_reveal.royal: Velvet curtains split smoothly left and right with gold fringe SVGs + red flower petals drifting down
step_2_reveal.birthday: Interactive balloons drift upward; tapping pops them with particle fragments and triggers confetti explosion

step_3_title.name: Title & Couple/Host Banner
elements: Host or Bride & Groom Names in grand display typography
Event main headline (e.g. 'The Royal Nikah & Walima')
Blessing or quote snippet
Background ambient music play/mute floating toggle

step_4_details_countdown.name: Scrolling Details & Countdown
elements: Formal invitation body copy
Blessing text / family compliments
Real-time Live Countdown timer (Days, Hours, Minutes, Seconds) with ticking animation
Event Switcher Tabs if multiple events (e.g., Mehndi / Nikah / Walima)

step_5_venue_directions_calendar.name: Venue & Action Suite
elements: Venue Name & Address card with custom SVG map pin
CTA 1: 'Get Directions' (opens Google Maps / Apple Maps link)
CTA 2: 'Add to Calendar' (generates both .ics file download and Google Calendar web URL)

step_6_rsvp.name: Interactive RSVP
elements: Status Choice: Yes / Maybe / Regretfully No
Guest Count selector (+1, +2, etc.)
Custom Dietary / Message input
CTA 1: 'Submit In-App RSVP'
CTA 2: 'Confirm on WhatsApp' (pre-fills WhatsApp message to host phone)

step_7_footer.name: Footer & Replay
elements: With compliments from {host_family_name}
Replay Intro Button (re-triggers opening reveal animation)
Brand signature: Powered by Daawat

methods: Phone OTP (Mocked WhatsApp code verification flow)

features: Stat cards (Total Cards, RSVPs Received, Total Guests)
Cards List with template badges & status pills

steps: 1. Event Type Selection (Wedding, Birthday, Anniversary, Party)
2. Template Picker (Royal Velvet & Gold, Confetti & Party Pop)
3. Host & Couple Details (Bride, Groom, Host Family, Custom Blessing)
4. Event Schedule (Multi-event setup: Date, Time, Venue, Map Link, Dress Code)
5. Soundtrack & Audio (Select built-in royalty-free audio track)

features: Direct 'Send via WhatsApp' button with pre-written polite invitation text

prefers_reduced_motion.fallback: Skip auto curtain parting and confetti particle loops; instantly display final card layout upon tap.

accessibility_and_motion.contrast_rules: All gold text over maroon must have at least 4.5:1 ratio (use #FDFBF7 or #E5C158 over #2B070C). Never place unshielded text on bright images.
accessibility_and_motion.touch_targets: Minimum 48px x 48px for mobile tap targets.

testing_attributes.rule: Every button, link, tab, input, modal, and key text element MUST include data-testid

image_urls.description: Royal Indian wedding couple in traditional red & gold attire
image_urls.usage: Seeded Wedding Royal Card Header / Hero Photo

image_urls.description: Intricate Henna patterned hands holding each other
Vibrant birthday party with balloons & festive decorations
image_urls.usage: Seeded Birthday Card Header / Hero Photo
Birthday Card Confetti Section / Background texture

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not center-align the app container globally. Keep natural visual layout.
Mobile-First execution: test all screens within max 430px mobile viewport simulation.
No horizontal overflow or scrolling on mobile screens.
Ensure all audio elements start muted or require explicit tap to play to comply with browser autoplay policies.
Ensure brand name 'Daawat' is configurable via single global constant in `src/config/brand.js`.
